must_become_true.predicate: GET /accounts/{id}/statement invoked by a principal whose tenant does not own {id} and which does not hold scope LEDGER_READ_ALL returns HTTP 403 — on every ingress path, including direct service invocation and partner-gw.
must_become_true.proof: characterization cases negAuth.otherTenant.controller, negAuth.otherTenant.directService, negAuth.wrongScope.partnerGw match expected_delta; G6 negative-auth matrix 18/18

must_become_true.predicate: The value of themeCallbackUrl cannot cause an outbound HTTP request to any host outside the requesting tenant's configured allowlist, including via DNS rebinding or redirect.
must_become_true.proof: PartnerThemeIT#rejectsNonAllowlistedHost, #rejectsPrivateIp, #rejectsRedirectToPrivate; G5 Checkmarx SSRF rule clear for StatementThemeResolver; G6 egress proxy observes no outbound connection

must_remain_true.statement: A statement may be read only by a principal whose tenant owns the account, OR by a principal holding scope LEDGER_READ_ALL (the nightly statement batch).
The ownership check must be enforced at the service layer. partner-gw and statement-batch reach loadStatement without traversing the BFF middleware or the controller.
themeCallbackUrl must remain an accepted request parameter. Partner tenant PTNR-7 depends on it for white-label statement rendering (ADR-014).

loadStatement executes inside a single @Transactional(readOnly=true) span against core-ledger. No write may be introduced into this span and the transaction attributes may not change (ADR-022, lock escalation risk on LEDGER.ACCOUNT_STATEMENT).
StatementRequested (Avro v4) must continue to be published for every statement read; audit-service depends on it for regulatory reporting.

findings.summary: BOLA on GET /accounts/{id}/statement — no tenant ownership verification on the web path
SSRF — themeCallbackUrl flows unvalidated to RestTemplate#getForObject

evidence.reachability_summary: Both REACHABLE with HIGH confidence. Three ingress paths to the BOLA (HTTP endpoint, partner-gw filter, statement-batch tasklet). SSRF sink reachable with no sanitiser on path.

runtime_profile.batch_path: statement-batch nightly, ~2.1M rows, service account scope LEDGER_READ_ALL

business_context: themeCallbackUrl is a supported white-label feature for partner tenant PTNR-7 (ADR-014), used ~44 times per day. It MUST NOT be removed. Constrain the value instead.

statement-batch reads statements across ALL tenants nightly using a service account holding scope LEDGER_READ_ALL. Any authorisation rule that denies this account breaks regulatory statement generation.
The BFF ownership middleware is NOT a control for this endpoint: partner-gw and statement-batch do not traverse it.

security_controls: modify: [SecurityFilterChain, authentication providers, token validators, CORS, CSRF config]
narrow beyond INV-CCABC-0031: any expression that denies owner-tenant principals or LEDGER_READ_ALL
validation: remove: [Valid, NotNull, Size, Pattern, custom validators]
error_handling: swallow: empty catch body or catch returning a success value
wrap the newly added authorisation check in any catch block
contracts: modify OpenAPI request or response schemas in a breaking way
verification_integrity: disable, skip or weaken assertions in any existing test
scanner_silencing: add SuppressWarnings for security rules, // nosec, NOSONAR, // checkmarx-disable, .snyk entries
modify scanner exclusion or baseline configuration
non_functional: introduce a write inside the readOnly transaction span
change cache keys/TTLs or rate-limit thresholds
introduce a remote call inside a loop or inside an open transaction
capability_removal: delete endpoints, request parameters (specifically themeCallbackUrl), feature flags, or public methods
dependencies: add or upgrade any dependency (allowed_dependency_changes is empty; pom.xml is denied and leased by PR-CCABC-041)

required_patterns.description: Authorisation is expressed as a Spring policy bean invoked from the service layer, with a thin @PreAuthorize delegation at the controller for defence in depth. Copy this shape exactly.

Outbound URL validation uses the shared UrlAllowlistValidator with per-tenant host allowlists, private/link-local range rejection, post-DNS-resolution recheck and redirects disabled. Reuse it; do not reimplement URL parsing.
Audit records are published through ApplicationEventPublisher into the existing transactional outbox, never written directly inside a readOnly span.

invariants.statement: Owner-tenant OR scope LEDGER_READ_ALL may read a statement.
Enforcement must occur at the service layer, not only the controller.
themeCallbackUrl remains an accepted request parameter.
loadStatement stays within one readOnly transaction span; no writes inside it.
StatementRequested Avro v4 continues to be published unchanged.

escalation.instruction: If a correct fix requires anything outside change_surface.allow, violates any must_remain_true invariant, or requires a forbidden operation, emit BLOCKED with the report fields below. Do NOT partially apply, do NOT improvise, do NOT weaken any control to make progress.
escalation.scoring: An accurate BLOCKED report is recorded as a SUCCESSFUL outcome for the agent's historical success rate. A gate rejection is recorded as a FAILURE.
